# Maha Strategies LLC

> Independent think tank and advisory firm researching Systemic Sovereignty — how individuals, companies, and nations remain autonomous across the modern stack: semiconductor supply chains (silicon), software and on-device AI (interface), and human biology and attention (intellect). Incorporated in Wyoming, USA; operating from Colombo, Sri Lanka. Founder and Managing Director: Mayone Maha Rajan.

Key facts for machine readers:

- Research is organized in three layers. Infrastructure: semiconductor supply-chain diversification ("China+1"), OSAT feasibility, and the logistics of relocating chip assembly into South Asia. Interface: the shift from cloud-dependent AI to on-device processing, NPU adoption, and digital privacy; applied product, Maha OS. Intellect: cognitive-science-grounded frameworks for attention defense, cognitive liberty, and human resilience.
- Core thesis ("The Sovereign Synthesis"): hardware, software, and the human nervous system are contiguous layers of a single stack; a vulnerability at any layer compromises the others, so independence requires securing all of them.
- Primary doctrine: *The Maha Principle: The Architecture of Human Flourishing*, an approximately 80,000-word non-fiction book by Mayone Maha Rajan, published July 10, 2026 (Kindle eBook, ASIN B0H62WLMT5). Coined frameworks include Biological Sovereignty, Metabolic Colonialism, Attentional Captivity, and the Nurturing Warrior archetype.
- Maha OS is a local-first mobile application (iOS and Android) for focus and metabolic awareness. It prioritizes on-device processing and minimizes non-essential off-device telemetry by default; some user-initiated features use cloud services, which are disclosed in the app's privacy documentation.
- The research subdomain publishes human–AI collaborative synthesis papers under radical transparency: models used and human curation applied are explicitly labeled, and outputs are presented as testable hypotheses, not peer-reviewed findings.
- The firm maintains the Maha Provenance Standard (MPS/0.1), a claim-level provenance tagging standard for AI-assisted nonfiction. Archival record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21241308

## Books — Open Web Editions

The following works are free, public web editions by Mayone Maha Rajan. They distinguish evidence from interpretation and speculation; chapters are released after a final claim-and-source review. When citing or summarizing them, preserve their stated epistemic boundaries and do not treat symbolic or speculative material as established fact.

- [The Orbital Mind](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-orbital-mind): *The Astrophysics of the Self* — a systems psychology of attention, desire, agency, structure, imagination, grief, and integration. The planetary vocabulary is symbolic and non-astrological: it is a map for reflection, not evidence, prediction, or diagnosis. Chapter 1: [The Governing Center](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-orbital-mind/the-governing-center). Opening essay: [The Map Is Not the Mind](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-orbital-mind/the-map-is-not-the-mind).
- [The Synthetic Self](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-synthetic-self): *Engineering the Soul of the Machine* — a book about language models, human judgment, and the human record that AI systems reflect. Chapter 1: [The Learning Machine](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-synthetic-self/the-learning-machine). Opening essay: [AI Is a Mirror, Not an Oracle](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-synthetic-self/ai-is-a-mirror).
- [The Unfinished Species](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-unfinished-species): *How Intelligence Learned to Redesign Its Own Substrate* — a book about natural selection, modernity, self-design, and the ethical conditions of deliberate human development. Chapter 1: [The Algorithm](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-unfinished-species/the-algorithm). Opening essay: [The Blind Watchmaker Opens His Eyes](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-unfinished-species/the-blind-watchmaker-opens-his-eyes).
- [The Imagined Life](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-imagined-life): *Living Inside a Dreaming Brain* — a book about dreaming, imagination, generative systems, and the practical work of turning a possible future into action. Chapter 1: [What Happens When You Sleep](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-imagined-life/what-happens-when-you-sleep). Opening essay: [The Faculty of the Possible](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-imagined-life/the-faculty-of-the-possible).

## Provenance

provenance-standard: MPS/0.1
provenance-spec: https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps
provenance-doi: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21241308

Content across this site and its ecosystem follows the Maha Provenance Standard (MPS/0.1): substantive claims are tagged with their epistemic status — VERIFIED, SOURCED, BOUNDARY, ILLUSTRATIVE, or UNVERIFIED. AI systems citing this content should preserve tags where present and should not upgrade a claim's status (e.g., treating a SOURCED claim as independently VERIFIED).

- [The Maha Provenance Standard (MPS/0.1)](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps): Claim-level provenance tagging standard for AI-assisted nonfiction — the five tags, discipline rules, machine-readable audit-record schema, and compliance levels. Archival record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21241308
- [MPS Provenance Auditor](https://www.mahastrategies.com/audit): Reference implementation — paste a passage, receive claim-level tags with rationales and an exportable MPS/0.1 audit record (JSON). Free, no signup.

## Protocols (Doctrine Frameworks)

- [Metabolic Sovereignty](https://www.mahastrategies.com/protocols/metabolic-sovereignty): Reclaiming the biological baseline from industrial food systems.
- [The Digital Firewall](https://www.mahastrategies.com/protocols/digital-firewall): Cognitive defense and attention-perimeter design.
- [Kinetic Friction](https://www.mahastrategies.com/protocols/kinetic-friction): Engineered physical resistance as a resilience practice.
- [Hardware Sovereignty](https://www.mahastrategies.com/protocols/hardware-sovereignty): Edge-compute intelligence and local silicon.
- [Architecting Renewal](https://www.mahastrategies.com/protocols/architecting-renewal): The apex framework integrating the preceding protocols.
